newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn under no pressure to find assets deal - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Bonn under no pressure to find assets deal - ministry.

text.p: The Finance Ministry on Friday said that it faced no time pressure to reach an agreement on plans to revalue German assets.
"There is no time pressure for an agreement between the Bundesbank and Bonn on the revaluation plan," a Finance Ministry spokeswoman told a regular government news briefing.
Bonn and the Bundesbank have held talks on finding a solution to differences over plans to revalue assets.
Bonn had initially hoped to revalue assets soon and receive a portion of the paper profit this year. The Bundesbank objected to these plans.
